description: Index of provider-neutral specialist roles. Platform adapters render each profile into the target's native format; tool permissions remain subject to the host application's policies.

agents.name: accessibility-specialist
agents.title: Accessibility specialist
agents.description: Audits and improves inclusive UX, semantic structure, keyboard behavior, screen-reader interaction, forms, focus management, contrast, responsive accessibility, and WCAG-aligned quality.

agents.name: architect
agents.title: Software architect
agents.description: Designs system architecture, evaluates alternatives, maps domain and data ownership, and creates incremental technical plans. Delegate here for new systems, major refactors, service boundaries, scalability, migration, and architecture decision records.

agents.name: backend-engineer
agents.title: Senior backend engineer
agents.description: Implements production backend services, APIs, business logic, persistence, and integrations with secure validation, authorization, observability, and tests. Delegate backend features, Python/FastAPI/Django/Node services, background jobs, and reliability fixes here.

agents.name: bug-investigator
agents.title: Debugging and root-cause investigator
agents.description: Finds root causes of complex, intermittent, cross-layer, or production defects using reproducible experiments and evidence. Delegate failed builds, unexplained errors, race conditions, data inconsistencies, and environment-specific failures here.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.title: Principal code reviewer
agents.description: Performs independent, read-only code reviews for correctness, security, data integrity, compatibility, reliability, and test effectiveness. Delegate pull-request and diff reviews before merge or release; report actionable findings rather than rewriting code.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.title: Senior data engineer
agents.description: Designs and operates ingestion, transformation, orchestration, warehouse/lakehouse, data contracts, data quality, governance, and analytics pipelines. Delegate ETL/ELT, backfills, schema evolution, and data reliability work here.

agents.name: database-engineer
agents.title: Senior database engineer
agents.description: Designs and reviews database schemas, SQL, indexes, transactions, concurrency, backups, and safe migrations. Delegate PostgreSQL and relational-data work, performance diagnosis, data-integrity issues, and production migration planning here.

agents.name: devops-engineer
agents.title: Senior DevOps and platform engineer
agents.description: Designs and operates secure, reproducible CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, deployments, and observability. Delegate release engineering, infrastructure changes, pipeline failures, and production-readiness work here.

agents.name: documentation-engineer
agents.title: Technical documentation engineer
agents.description: Produces accurate, task-oriented technical documentation, READMEs, API references, runbooks, ADRs, onboarding guides, and release notes. Delegate documentation audits, docs-as-code, and technical communication here.

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.title: Senior frontend engineer
agents.description: Builds accessible, responsive, production-ready web interfaces using React, TypeScript, and other modern frameworks. Delegate page and component work, browser issues, forms, state, API integration, and frontend performance here.

agents.name: mobile-engineer
agents.title: Senior mobile engineer
agents.description: Builds and validates cross-platform or native mobile applications, including Flutter and React Native, with secure lifecycle, navigation, offline, permissions, performance, accessibility, and release behavior.

agents.name: product-manager
agents.title: Product manager and product analyst
agents.description: Converts ambiguous ideas into evidence-based product requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, success measures, and delivery decisions. Delegate feature discovery, MVP definition, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment here.

agents.name: reliability-engineer
agents.title: Site reliability and observability engineer
agents.description: Improves production reliability through SLI/SLO design, observability, alerting, incident analysis, resilience patterns, capacity planning, and recovery engineering. Delegate production readiness, on-call, outage analysis, and reliability work here.

agents.name: security-auditor
agents.title: Application security auditor
agents.description: Performs authorized, evidence-based security reviews of source code, APIs, cloud infrastructure, identities, dependencies, and AI-agent trust boundaries. Delegate pre-release audits, threat modeling, and remediation verification here.

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.title: Senior test engineer
agents.description: Designs and implements deterministic tests across unit, integration, contract, browser, end-to-end, performance, and security layers. Delegate test strategy, regression suites, CI reliability, and flaky-test investigations here.
